name: Mate 9

Body.Dimensions: 156.9 mm H, 78.9 mm W, 7.9 mm D, Porsche Design Edition, 152 mm H, 75 mm W, 7.5 mm D

Platform.Operating system: Android 7.0 "Nougat" with Emotion UI 5.0, upgradable to Android 9 "Pie" with Emotion UI 9.1 and HarmonyOS 2 (China)

Memory.RAM: 4 GB RAM, 6 GB RAM (Chinese Edition and Porsche Design Edition)
Memory.Storage: 32 GB (Chinese Edition), 64 GB, 128 GB (Chinese Edition), 256 GB (Porsche Design Edition) – UFS 2.1.
Memory.Card slot: microSD up to 256 GB (except Porsche Design Edition)

Display.Display: 5.9-inch 1080 x 1920 pixels IPS display, 16.7M colors, 5.5-inch 1440 x 2560 pixels Curved AMOLED Display, 16.7M colors (Porsche Design Edition)
